def compute_percentage(balances, label):
    min_bal = min(balances)
    max_bal = max(balances)
    range_val = max_bal - min_bal
    avg = sum(balances) / len(balances)
    percentage = (range_val / avg) * 100
    print(f"{label}:")
    print(f"  Min: {min_bal}, Max: {max_bal}, Range: {range_val}")
    print(f"  Average: {avg:.2f}")
    print(f"  Range as % of average: {percentage:.2f}%")
    print()
    return percentage

pct_1962_1963 = compute_percentage(balances_1962_1963, "1962-1963")
pct_1963_1964 = compute_percentage(balances_1963_1964, "1963-1964")
pct_1964_1965 = compute_percentage(balances_1964_1965, "1964-1965")

print(f"Highest percentage: {max(pct_1962_1963, pct_1963_1964, pct_1964_1965):.2f}%")
